_comment: Checkpoints ship BF16 RMSNorm gains — the metal gain-reader symbols must match. Text weights live under `language_model.model.*`. `max_blocks_per_seq` is a DEPLOYMENT constant, not a checkpoint field: the family is long-context (>=128k positions), so size the KV block table for 32k tokens (2048 x block_size 16) rather than the 128-block (~2k) default that would silently truncate. The two attention classes share their on-disk projection/norm leaves — the `*_global` DSL names (the global class's wider head) map back to the same disk tensors as the sliding class. mlx sets `scale = 1.0` unconditionally for BOTH attention classes (no config field carries it — the Granite path reads `attention_multiplier`), and checkpoints omit it. Rope scalars are nested per attention class under `rope_parameters` in the verbatim config (newer transformers serialization), so they are ALIASED to the flat names the rope codegen reads; `sliding_window_pattern` is derived from `layer_types`.
